_comment: Adverse-condition segmentation. clear→fog→rain→night→snow drift stream. Cityscapes label format, ignore_index=255. See docs/datasets/acdc.md. Calibrate tau_drift per hardware. train_frac/val_frac CHANGED 2026-08-30 (0.7/0.1 -> 0.2/0.0): weights already exist on disk (never trained by this harness), so train_split() only ever fed _build_cv_reference()'s luminance histogram, which is internally capped at ~1000 samples regardless of input size -- the old 70% allocation (~1404 images) was mostly wasted. val_split() has zero consumers anywhere in experiments/run_experiment.py's actual per-run pipeline (only experiments/calibrate_drift_threshold.py, a separate script, reads it) -- dropped to 0.0 entirely. Frees ~80% of the trimmed manifest for the stream instead of ~20%. Manifest currently covers train+val only (2006 rows) -- ACDC's public test split (2000 more frames) has no released GT masks, so preprocess_acdc.py never ingests it; those frames COULD be added to the stream later since streaming is label-free (I4), but that needs a preprocess_acdc.py change, not done here.
